title: You Can Craft It Now
description: adds crafting recipes to items that dont have crafting recipes
body:
you know all of thoes items you cant craft? well guess what, you can craft it now :D
this mod makes certain items like the saddle, nametag, xp bottle, enchanted golden apple more accessable by adding recipes for said items


the items that this mod adds recipes for are, 
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

saddles, leather/iron/gold/diamond horse armor, chainmail armor, xp bottles, name tags, nether wart (converting nether wart blocks back into nether wart), poisonus potatoes, and the uncraftable arrow/potion (which have effectively no use)

</details>
